channel.title: The Drill Down: Detroit Lions
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Bears at Lions
item.description: Thu 11/26 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: CHI -2.5 · O/U 55.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 48% | Chicago's fifth-ranked passing attack has to exploit Detroit's middle of the field, where opponents average +0.54 EPA per throw, the worst mark in the league. Amon-Ra St. Brown draws 28% of Detroit's targets, and his 0.68 opportunity rating will face a Bears pass defense ranked fifth. Our model has Detroit at 54%, while the market has Chicago at 52%, and home field accounts for most of that gap.

item.title: Week 11: Buccaneers at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: DET -6.5 · O/U 46.5 | Model DET 74% vs. market 71% | The game likely turns on Detroit's pressure, since Tampa Bay's offense ranks 32nd in EPA per dropback and must function while the Lions' defense ranks 14th against the blitz. Baker Mayfield averages -1.26 EPA per dropback under pressure, and Detroit's rush ranks 6th, so Mayfield will spend much of the game in the spot where his numbers collapse. We have Detroit at 74%, a touch above the market's 71%, with the starting quarterback spot doing most of the lifting.

item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | The trenches decide this game: Detroit's pass rush generates pressure on 23% of dropbacks, and New England's line allows that same rate, so Maye's protection will shape everything. Amon-Ra St. Brown draws 33% of Detroit's targets and runs routes against a New England pass defense ranked 21st. Our model puts Detroit at 54% against the market's 57%, with the rushing matchup providing most of the lift toward the Lions.
